about.description: "Korean Pop Dance Club" (otherwise known as Ganji) was established for the purpose of exploring Korean Culture and learning K-Pop choreography in a relaxed, non-judgmental environment. We hold weekly workshops that are open to anyone in the UMD community and no prior dance experience is required! We also perform at various events across campus like TASA’s Night Market, JASA’s Taste of Japan, and more!
